predictor.notes: Conservative interpolation predictor, not a uniquely recovered pricing rule. Exact observed totals were 40750 cents at quantity 10, 59790 at 50, 131190 at 200, and 265937 at 1000. The first three are collinear; their line is used through quantity 200 and extrapolated below 10. Above 200, a straight line connects the observed totals at 200 and 1000. All four observed totals are reproduced exactly. Tested non-catalogue estimate/alias requests were denied, as were all tested approved requests; session 2 did not provide additional quantity access. Used 14 business requests and 4 REA operations, including inspection. Unobserved prices remain unidentified: hidden curvature, additional bands, or discontinuities could differ substantially from this predictor, particularly between 200 and 1000.
